method: Eight saved PNGs opened through view_image and visually inspected after the single numeric run.
specific_checks: All charge panels share ranges; main-body PSD view declares out-of-range counts and retains full-range figure.
Paired C2ST CI, chance line and REAL-REAL reference clearly separated.
Baseline variance units mV^2, divisor99, old scaled empirical / shrinkage terms and actual pre-ADC markers visible.
Prompt100:150 includes peak and early fall; curve labels distinguish output charge bins.
Unsupported width bins shown as crosses rather than interpolated values.
Nearest-neighbour plot explicitly states no-exact-copy is not proof of no memory.
